rawContent:
all the women, all the women
are inside me now
shouting that this is a fine day for it...

Starting our International @WomensDay celebrations early & making it a 3 day event! Today we've @JulWe1 with 'All the Women', after @HildaSheehan! https://t.co/2rk6xHWtit #TimesUp #Metoo

Today for #InternationalWomensDay , we've Deborah Alma @emergencypoet on the naissance of her anthology '#MeToo', launching (in Scotland) at @StAnzaPoetry. A must-read https://t.co/2rk6xHWtit

With almost every submission came a covering letter that was often harrowing to read...

IS&T editor Helen Ivory @nellivory will be launching this tonight at 6.15pm! Read @emergencypoet on how '#MeToo- rallying against sexual harrassment- a women’s poetry anthology' came into being here https://t.co/7Qd07IRBAI. And then buy it! https://t.co/fox8IIiDSV
